hook: Gemini’s Computer Use lets the Mac app run tasks automatically.
hooks: Gemini’s Computer Use lets the Mac app run tasks automatically.
It can fill forms, edit photos, and build slides while you work.
Google says Gemini clicks, types, and navigates menus in a background window.
what_happened: Google added a Computer Use feature to Gemini’s Mac app that performs multistep tasks across files, apps, and websites in the background.
why_it_matters: Google says users describe a goal and Gemini does the work in a background window, leaving the screen and cursor free.
the_catch: Rolling out in U.S. English only; needs an Apple Silicon Mac on macOS Sequoia 15.0+ and a Google AI Plus, Pro or Ultra plan.
caption: Google’s Gemini app now includes a Computer Use feature that runs Mac applications and completes desktop chores in the background. Would you trust it with your invoices?
alt_text: The carousel explains that Google’s Gemini Mac app now has a Computer Use feature that runs background tasks on the Mac.
picked_because: Readers would miss a new AI assistant that can automate Mac desktop tasks, saving time and boosting productivity.

es.hook: Computer Use de Gemini permite que la aplicación Mac ejecute tareas automáticamente.
es.what_happened: Google añadió la función Computer Use a la aplicación Mac de Gemini, que realiza tareas multietapa en archivos, aplicaciones y sitios web en segundo plano.
es.why_it_matters: Google dice que los usuarios describen un objetivo y Gemini realiza el trabajo en una ventana en segundo plano, dejando la pantalla y el cursor libres.
es.the_catch: Se lanza solo en inglés de EE. UU.; requiere un Mac con Apple Silicon con macOS Sequoia 15,0 + y un plan Google AI Plus, Pro o Ultra.
